fields.description: The Grove is Sobha Sanctuary’s enclave of independent estate villas in Dubailand. Four-, five- and six-bedroom homes sit among waterways, linear parks and shaded routes, with planting used to separate the houses from busier community areas. The plans distinguish private plot area from saleable home area, giving families two different measures of space to compare.

overview: The four-bedroom Type A pairs a downstairs guest bedroom with three bedrooms upstairs and a study. Six-bedroom Type A adds a further level and lift. Layouts and plot shapes are type-specific; a pool illustration is not a universal specification.
research.locationNote: Dubailand, Dubai, as described in the developer’s own project materials. No nearby district is substituted for the project address.
research.priceNote: The own developer page fetched on 31 October 2026 advertises AED 9,420,000 from, subject to inventory availability. This is a published guide, not a checked available unit, valuation or binding offer. Other historical launch advertisements may use a different price or unit mix.
research.paymentNote: Silver Oak publishes 20% booking, four 10% construction instalments at 6, 12, 24 and 30 months, and 40% handover. Other marketing sources describe different promotional splits. No current signed developer payment sheet was available; this is an attributed broker example.
research.handoverNote: Developer catalogue: 2029. A broker’s DLD-register summary reports 31 August 2030; neither establishes the selected unit’s contractual handover. Confirm the SPA rather than resolving the difference by assumption.
